actualScope.readingOrder: Read both complete target manuscripts and diagram JSON files first, then compared the complete English manuscript and original diagram. Did not consult author verdicts or other reviews.
actualScope.content: Complete visible title/description, metadata, prose, headings, table, localized alt text, diagram title/description/all five steps, code and output explanations. Checked claims, conditions, uncertainty, host versus game-target support, licensing distinctions, proposed versus executed validation, dates, versions, numbers and units.
actualScope.mechanicalChecks: All four code fences (ini/gdscript/sh/text) are byte-identical to source. All prose external URL sequences match source. All inline-code tokens and counts are preserved; PATH is naturally reordered in the localized macOS sentence. Both diagram JSON files parse and retain the five process/result steps in source order. sourceSha256 matches the current English source.

assessment: No actionable translation defect identified in the reviewed versions. Both translations retain the article’s limited Godot-only executed check and distinguish it from proposed engine evaluation.
limits: AI review only; no human or native-speaker review claimed.
No engines, examples, target exports or rendering benchmarks were executed by this reviewer.
No independent verification of the underlying product/version/license claims against live vendor sources; reviewed fidelity to supplied English source.
No browser or rendered SVG layout inspection. Draft image references are local filenames intended for the translation pipeline; final routing and asset integration were not reviewed.
Draft frontmatter uses pipeline state/source tracking instead of published English publication/review fields; final publication metadata integration was not reviewed.
